description: List one store's current coupon codes and deals, soonest ending first, optionally for one country. Returns up to 10 offers with code (or none), end date, countries and links, plus the store's total number of offers and a link to all of them on Coupossum.

country.description: ISO country code, e.g. CH or US. Returns offers for that country plus worldwide ones.

store.description: Store name, domain or Coupossum store slug

name: get_store_offers
title: Get a store's current offers
